title: Luke Skywalker's Failure
description: Exhorted by Yoda, Luke Skywalker tried to levitate his downed starfighter from the swamp on Dagobah where it had crash-landed. Although the ship began to emerge, it soon slid back again, and Luke was unable to complete what he considered an impossible task. In less than a minute Yoda proved him wrong, raising the starship and gracefully depositing it on shore. Luke couldn't believe what he was seeing...which is precisely why he "failed," according to his teacher.
